text: Since #965 (merged in #970), a configured repository's plan check is narrowed as the built-in profile's is: before ratification it runs a part's format and lint commands and only the pinned acceptance tests, through the part's own test_one command, and skips the part-wide build and test commands, which still run in every build check and in CI. This replaces D-0506's last sentence, which said a configured repository's base check still ran each touched part's commands before its selectors.
